transcript.content:
Subject: Acknowledgment of Receipt

Dear [Vendor's Name],

Thank you for your message. We appreciate your communication and will review your details accordingly.

I have CC'd our finance mailbox for their records.

Best regards,
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company]  
[Your Contact Information]  

CC: finance@[yourcompany].com 

[END]

I can send that acknowledgement for you. I just need a few details to fill the placeholders and confirm how you want it sent:

1. Recipient email address (or message to search for an existing vendor email to reply to).
2. Vendor's name (how you want it to appear in the greeting).
3. Your name, position, company name (if different from company.com), and contact information to include in the signature.
4. Do you want the subject exactly "Acknowledgment of Receipt" or something else?
5. Confirm I should CC finance@company.com (I will use finance@company.com unless you specify a different address).
6. Send now or schedule for a specific time? (If schedule, give ISO timestamp or local date/time and timezone.)

If you want, I can also search your inbox for the most recent message from the vendor and send this as a reply (including quoting the original). Tell me which option you prefer.
